lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.campaign_progress_on_approval()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/campaign_progress_on_approval`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.notify_on_level_up()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/notify_on_level_up`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.notify_on_submission_change()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/notify_on_submission_change`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.rls_auto_enable()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/rls_auto_enable`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
